newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Values steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Values steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at steady to higher levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded versus no trades Thursday. Bids and offers included:
- One barge, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offer 165 percent.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, next week, no bid, offer 180 percent.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi, bid one barge each week at 155 percent of tariff, offer 160 percent, up five percentage points from Thursday.
- Eight barges, Lacrosse-Savage, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of April, bid 185 percent, offer 195 percent.
- Eight barges, Lacrosse-Savage, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of May, bid 165 percent, up five percentage points, offer 180 percent.
- 10 barges, St Paul-Savage, Mississippi, two each week of June, bid 160 percent, offer 170 percent.
